name: StableGen (Blender add-on) v0.4.0
summary: Free open-source Blender add-on that textures meshes and whole scenes with diffusion models via a local or networked ComfyUI, and since v0.4.0 builds rigged characters from one prompt: TRELLIS.2 makes the mesh, SkinTokens adds skeleton and skin weights, generated views are projected as texture. Bakes PBR maps, retargets Mixamo animations, exports glTF/FBX.

access.notes: Add-on code GPL-3.0; generated assets follow the licences of the models used in ComfyUI (SDXL, TRELLIS.2, etc.). Needs ComfyUI and at least 8 GB VRAM for SDXL texturing. Blender 4.2-4.5 or 5.1+.

procedure: Download the zip for your OS from the v0.4.0 release page
Install it in Blender via Preferences > Add-ons > Install from disk
Set up a ComfyUI server (local or on your network) following the Installation wiki
Place cameras, write a prompt, click Generate; or use the prompt-to-rigged-character flow

verdict.why: Mature add-on (1.1k+ GitHub stars, since 2025) with a substantial new release: prompt to rigged, textured, exportable character inside Blender, free and local. Minus: heavy ComfyUI setup, output licence depends on chosen models.
